description: Redesign Registration page: remove role selector, add country code picker for phone, add OTP verification step, auto-assign viewer role
steps: 1. Create src/components/auth/CountryCodePicker.tsx - A searchable country code dropdown component. Show country flag emoji + code (+91, +1, +44, etc.). Default to India (+91). Dark themed dropdown matching the app's glassmorphism design. Searchable with keyboard input. Store and output in E.164 format. Include a comprehensive list of countries with their dial codes and flag emojis. Use Radix UI primitives or a custom dropdown with the existing UI components.

2. Create src/components/auth/OTPInput.tsx - A 6-digit OTP input component. Six separate input boxes that auto-advance on type. Emerald border on focus. Backspace goes to previous box. Paste support for full 6-digit code. Dark themed matching the app design. Auto-focus first box on mount.

3. Redesign src/pages/auth/Register.tsx - REMOVE the Role dropdown entirely from step 2. Auto-assign role as 'viewer' for all public registrations (hardcode in the signup metadata). Replace the plain text phone input with the CountryCodePicker component integrated with a phone number input. The phone field should combine country code + number and store in E.164 format (+917666971183). Add Step 3: OTP verification after step 2. Show the OTPInput component. Send OTP via Supabase phone auth (supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ phone })) OR gracefully skip if no SMS provider is configured. Show 'Resend' button with 60-second cooldown timer. If OTP sending fails (no provider configured), show a 'Phone verification pending' badge and allow completing registration. Update the progress indicator to show 3 steps instead of 2. Validate phone number is in E.164 format before proceeding.

4. Create src/pages/auth/OTPVerification.tsx - Optional standalone OTP verification page/component that can be reused. This can be a wrapper around OTPInput with the resend logic, countdown timer, and verification API call. Include success/error states with appropriate feedback.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
Registration form has NO role selector/dropdown visible to users
All public registrations auto-assign role as 'viewer'
Phone input has a country code picker with flag emojis and search
Phone number is stored in E.164 format
OTP step appears after personal info step
OTP input has 6 separate boxes with auto-advance
If SMS provider is not configured, registration completes with 'Phone verification pending' badge
CountryCodePicker is a reusable component in src/components/auth/
OTPInput is a reusable component in src/components/auth/
verification: Run `pnpm build` and confirm zero errors and successful bundle output
findings: Build passes cleanly. Custom CountryCodePicker built instead of react-phone-number-input to avoid CSS conflicts with dark theme. OTP verification gracefully falls back to 'pending' badge when SMS provider is not configured. Registration uses 3-step progress indicator.
